team.name: Sample Studio
team.tagline: Five fictional roles, one shared workspace.

focus.label: 01 / A FICTIONAL STUDIO
focus.heading: A little clarity. A better next step.
focus.description: Explore how roles, conversations and shared tasks can fit together. All records are fabricated.

roles.name: Planner
roles.label: Strategy & priorities
roles.summary: A clear goal makes room for good work.
roles.heading: Give the work a direction.
roles.intro: A fictional planning role turns broad ideas into clear outcomes and a manageable next step.

focus.title: Clarify the outcome
focus.detail: Describe what a useful result would look like.

focus.title: Choose a first step
focus.detail: Keep the next deliverable small enough to review.

roles.responsibility: Priorities, scope and clear acceptance criteria.
roles.handoff: Share a clear brief with the Coordinator.
roles.deliverable: A short brief with goals, options and the next step.

roles.name: Coordinator
roles.label: Workflow & handoffs
roles.summary: One board. A clear next action.
roles.heading: Help the pieces fit together.
roles.intro: This fictional workflow role keeps tasks, owners and handoffs easy to follow.

focus.title: Name an owner
focus.detail: Every task should have one accountable role.

focus.title: Show the blocker
focus.detail: Describe what is needed before the task can move.

roles.responsibility: Task ownership, readiness and handoff notes.
roles.handoff: Pass ready tasks to the Maker; send decisions to the Planner.
roles.deliverable: A clear queue with owners, status and next actions.

roles.name: Maker
roles.label: Drafts & prototypes
roles.specialty: Turn a brief into a first draft
roles.heading: Make the next idea tangible.
roles.intro: This fictional creative role prepares small drafts that the team can discuss and improve.

focus.title: Begin with a sketch
focus.detail: Create a simple version of the proposed result.

focus.title: Keep it reviewable
focus.detail: Show the key choices and open questions.

roles.handoff: Send a reviewable draft to the Reviewer.
roles.deliverable: A first draft with notes on the main choices.

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.label: Quality & feedback
roles.specialty: Check the draft against the goal
roles.summary: Good feedback points to the next change.
roles.heading: Make feedback easy to act on.
roles.intro: This fictional review role compares a draft with its intended outcome and suggests useful improvements.

focus.title: Check the goal
focus.detail: Look for gaps between the brief and the draft.

focus.title: Explain the change
focus.detail: Attach a concrete next step to each observation.

roles.responsibility: Quality checks, useful feedback and open risks.
roles.handoff: Return actionable notes to the Maker and unresolved choices to the Planner.
roles.deliverable: A concise review with strengths, gaps and next changes.

roles.name: Scout
roles.label: Ideas & references
roles.summary: Bring options back to the team.
roles.heading: Open a few useful directions.
roles.intro: This fictional exploration role maps possibilities and gives the team a small set of ideas to discuss.

focus.title: Explore the options
focus.detail: Describe a few possible directions and their tradeoffs.

roles.responsibility: Option sketches, reference notes and open questions.
roles.handoff: Share a concise set of options with the Planner.
roles.deliverable: An options note with tradeoffs and questions.
prompts: List what we need to learn

tasks.title: Outline a project brief
tasks.description: Define the goal for a fictional neighborhood guide.

tasks.title: Arrange the first handoff
tasks.description: Describe the inputs and owner for a small draft.

tasks.title: Sketch the opening page
tasks.description: Make a simple draft for the fictional guide.

tasks.title: Prepare a quality checklist
tasks.description: Keep readability and clear navigation visible.

tasks.title: Map three possible directions
tasks.description: Compare a short guide, a map and a small directory.

tasks.title: Choose the next fictional scenario
tasks.description: Waiting for a local choice in this demo.
